# Pro Peach Cleaning – Utah

> Pro Peach Cleaning, LLC provides professional house cleaning in Salt Lake City and the surrounding Salt Lake Valley (Millcreek, Holladay, Murray, Cottonwood Heights, Sugar House, South Salt Lake), Utah: standard (recurring) cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, Airbnb and vacation-rental turnovers, commercial/office cleaning and post-construction cleaning. Cleaners are background-checked and bring their own supplies. Every clean is backed by a 24-hour free touch-up: if anything on the checklist is missed, tell us within 24 hours and we come back at no charge. Women-, veteran- and Latino-owned; licensed, bonded and insured; only 4% of cleaner applicants are hired; eco-friendly products. Pricing is based on home size and cleaning type; customers get an instant exact price when booking online. Open 7 days, 8 AM–8 PM. Book online or call/text (385) 217-9244. Email clean@propeachcleaning.com. Pro Peach also serves metro Atlanta, Georgia at https://propeachcleaning.com/.
